PEPPERNEON BAY

Pepper just stepped off the bus in Neon Bay: a sun-soaked city of neon hotels, palm trees and very fast cars. Borrow any ride, fly the Sky Hopper, race boats round the harbour, tear up Sunset Ridge in a thunderstorm and become a legend.

Version 2.0 · 8 story missions · weather · phone · helicopter · boats · pool hall

Controls

On footWASD walk · Shift sprint · Space jump · drag the mouse to look around
CarsWalk up to any car and press F. W/S gas and brake, A/D steer, Space handbrake drift, H horn, R radio
MissionsYellow markers are story missions, blue are pizza jobs, purple is the street race. In a taxi press T for fares
Wanted starsStealing cars near cops, ramming them or hitting people earns stars. Break line of sight to lose them, or drive into the Spray Shack
PlacesE uses shops: Drip Boutique (outfits and hats), Turbo Motors (cars), Rafi's Garage (save and pick your cars)
Extras15 hidden cassette tapes and stunt ramps for airtime bonuses. C cycles chase, hood, cinematic and top-down cameras. M map, Esc pause
Nitro and combosN fires nitro (drifting refills it). Chain drifts, near misses and big air for combo points that turn into cash. Crashing drops the combo
Sky Hopper and boatsHelicopter at the Sky Tours helipad on the beach: W/S fly, A/D turn, Space up, Shift down. Boats wait at the marina by the docks
Your phoneQ opens it: contacts, weather, places, map and camera. When it rings, Q answers for a street job
Things to doArcade, Hoop Court, the Neon Cue Club pool hall, Taco Comet, the Neon Needle, Stunt Park and Sunset Ridge. Drive into Rafi's Garage and press E to tune your ride
Photo modeP freezes time. Drag to orbit, WASD moves, Q/E down/up, 1-5 filters, Enter takes the photo
